facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jim found the treasure at last! But he learned bigger lessons. Growing up is the real treasure. Adventure teaches lessons.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jim and his friends finally discovered the treasure in a cave. There were gold coins and jewels everywhere! But Jim felt strangely calm about the treasure. He realized that courage, friendship, and wisdom were more valuable. Adventure teaches lessons. The real treasure was everything Jim learned on this journey.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: After weeks of danger and adventure, Jim and his allies finally found the legendary treasure. The cave was filled with mountains of gold coins, sparkling jewels, and ancient artifacts. Surprisingly, Jim did not feel the excitement he had expected when he first saw the map. Instead, he felt a quiet understanding that the real treasures were the lessons he had learned. Adventure teaches lessons. However, the gold was still divided fairly among those who deserved it. Because Jim had grown so much during this adventure, he valued wisdom over wealth. The frightened boy who found a map had become a thoughtful, courageous young man.
